name: layout-critique-report
description: v0.31.5.415 — the layout critique is applied to the USER'S OWN design, not just to generated schemes. Captures the printable report via the same window.open intercept the drawing-set scenarios use, asserts the Layout critique section exists with measured verdicts, asserts failures/warnings sort above passes, asserts the bedroom runners are NOT flagged (the four false alarms this ships to fix), then renders the captured HTML into the page to screenshot the real table.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: wait-report-captured
steps.failMessage: openDesignReport() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-critique-section
steps.eval:
(function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; const i = html.indexOf('

Layout critique

'); if (i < 0) throw new Error('report has no Layout critique section in Pro'); const table = html.slice(i, html.indexOf('', i)); if (!/Layout quality \d+ over [1-9]/.test(table)) throw new Error('critique section has no applicable checks: ' + table.slice(0,300)); const verdicts = [...table.matchAll(/(pass|warn|fail)<\/td>/g)].map(m => m[1]); if (verdicts.length < 2) throw new Error('expected several measured verdicts, got ' + JSON.stringify(verdicts)); const rank = v => v === 'fail' ? 0 : v === 'warn' ? 1 : 2; for (let k = 1; k < verdicts.length; k++) if (rank(verdicts[k]) < rank(verdicts[k-1])) throw new Error('verdicts not sorted worst-first: ' + JSON.stringify(verdicts)); window.__critiqueTable = table; })()

steps.name: assert-runners-not-flagged
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__critiqueTable; const runners = (t.match(/bedside runner/g) || []).length; if (runners < 2) throw new Error('expected the default flat\'s bedside runners to be recognised as runners, found ' + runners + ' — this is the false-alarm class the release fixes'); if (/-\d+\.\d+ m past/.test(t)) throw new Error('negative overhang printed as "past" — nonsense copy'); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-critique
steps.eval: (function(){ const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Layout critique'); if (!h) throw new Error('rendered report has no Layout critique heading'); h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); })()
